title: course.json
description: A course: its names, its lecture order, its theme and the platform build its pages are pinned to.

title.description: the Hebrew name of the course

titleEn.description: the English name, shown in its own bidi isolate

theme.description: the course's token set; `PUT /courses/{c}/theme` is what validates it properly

platform.description: the platform hash a published page loads (`/lib/<hash>`), or `dev`

lectures.description: the lecture ids in the lecturer's own order; the importer appends, never reorders
